description: Puts every row a civil_write_tables run touched back as it was before the run: deletes rows it created, restores rows it changed or deleted (a merging table's row is replaced whole). Works on a run that stopped part-way too. Warns where a row changed after the run. What CIVIL NX deleted along with a row (elements on a deleted node, loads on a deleted element) is not part of the run and does not come back. Default: the latest run not yet undone. Previews unless apply: true.
name: civil_write_tables_undo
title: Undo a civil_write_tables run
